Hey guys, I am struggling to kill the mechanical bosses on my own single player world. First of all, is there an easy way to host my own world for multiplayer? Secondly, is anyone willing to hop in and help me out?

If you're playing from Steam you can just hit Host and Play.

Your steam friends will be able to just join you that way. Although I recommend setting a password just in case someone else joins.

If you still want to do it solo:

The Destroyer is the easiest Mechanical Boss to kill IMO. Make an arena with enough room to move around. Include campfires and heart lanterns so have higher health regen. Use buff potions. Hell, make a little house and put the nurse in it so you can magic mirror over to her and heal up to full if you need to.
Make a few small pools of honey to jump in for the regen buff too.

If you find a heart/star statue and have the npc that sells wires and switches you can create a machine that gives you health + mana every other seconds. It's not a lot of health, but combined with the dryad, heart lantern, honey pool, you can get a good sustain and you can teleport to the nurse if you feel threatened.

Also check your potions, some gives you 20% health, you can also get a buff from cooking a fish that is easily farmed (the buff last way more than a boss fight).
